note: THE SLICE'S OWN EVIDENCE, kept outside projects/ because the slice is not a film. These two approvals were taken on 2026-11-09 to prove the illustration slot class end to end — the gate posted the pictures, the owner approved them, and a cut used one. They are recorded here so that record survives, and NOT in a film's approvals file, because no film approved them.
why_migrated: Approvals became per-film state on 2026-11-11. The shared tracked file meant one film's script approval covered every picture in the library, under that film's name, and dirtied a tracked file in the pull-only runner on every approval.
